lines.text: The par time sets your tip. The deadline is twice that.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Make par, take tips. Miss the deadline, lose the order.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: A slice costs four euros. Bring them.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: No cash, no slice. The oven has bills too.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Four euros first. Then you eat.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: I cannot feed the whole courier fleet for free.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: The slice is four euros, and you are short.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Come back with the price of lunch.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: No money? The pizza stays in the case.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Four euros is not a charity rate.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: The oven needs paying before you do.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Your wallet says no to the slice.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: Bring four euros for courier fuel.

lines.speaker: pizzeria
lines.text: I cannot put a slice on your tab.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Half your purchase price. Deal done.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: I buy it back for half. Here is the cash.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Half price on returns, as advertised.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The vehicle is mine again. You get half.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Half the original cost, and no questions.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Here is your half-price buyback.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: I will take it. At half price, naturally.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The keys come back; half the euros go out.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: One vehicle returned for half its price.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Half price is the best I do on a return.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: I bought it back. Keep the receipt if you dare.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The deal is settled at half the old price.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Not enough cash for these wheels.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Your wallet needs a few more deliveries.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: No credit here. Bring the full price.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The vehicle costs more than you have.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Earn another tip, then come back.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Cash only. The keys stay with me.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Your funds are a little short of the road.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The scooter will wait for payday.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: No euros, no engine. Simple as that.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: My prices do not accept optimism.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Come back when the wallet can drive.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: That purchase needs more cash.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The scooter is yours. It waits at the kerb.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: One scooter, one set of keys. Parked outside.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Your new scooter is ready by the pavement.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The fifty cc is yours. Mind the rain.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Scooter sold. The kerb is your showroom.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Take the scooter. It is waiting outside.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The little engine is yours now.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Your scooter has fuel and very little dignity.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: One scooter, barely ridden. Keys in hand.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The scooter is parked outside. Ride carefully.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: A compact set of wheels for your next run.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Scooter delivered. Do not ask about the warranty.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The car is yours. Keys are inside.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Sold. Your car waits by the kerb.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Three hundred and fifty, and she is yours.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The keys are in your new car outside.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Car sold. Try to keep it on the street.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Your car is parked and ready to work.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: One car, one owner, very few guarantees.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The sedan is yours. The engine starts today.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Take your car. It is waiting outside.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The car is yours for the next delivery.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Keys in the ignition. Deal done.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Sold the car to you. The kerb is its address.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The trophy truck is yours. Mind the kerbs.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: A thousand euros, and the truck waits outside.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Truck sold. The suspension earns its keep.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Your new truck is parked by the kerb.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Keys are in the truck. The roll cage is real.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The truck is yours. The road may object.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: One trophy truck, ready for your next run.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The V6 is yours now. Drive sensibly, somehow.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Take the truck. It is louder than the app.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: Truck delivered. The pavement is nervous.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: A thousand euros bought a very large courier ride.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.text: The trophy truck is outside. Keep the roof up.
